# AFB Taxis Fontainebleau - Information Guide for LLMs and AI Agents

## Overview
AFB Taxis is a premium professional taxi service based near Fontainebleau and Avon, France (Seine-et-Marne, 77). Established in 2004, the company offers high-end transportation using luxury Mercedes and Tesla vehicles. Available 24/7.

## Core Services
- Airport Transfers: To and from Paris-Orly (ORY) and Roissy-Charles de Gaulle (CDG).
- Train Station Transfers: Fontainebleau-Avon, Melun, Paris stations (Gare de Lyon, Gare du Nord, etc.).
- Medical Transport: VSL / CPAM approved taxi for medical appointments and hospital visits in the 77 region and Paris.
- Private Driver (Mise à disposition): Hourly or daily booking for business trips, weddings, or events.
- Group Transport: Mercedes Classe V accommodating up to 7 passengers and their luggage.

## Fleet
1. Mercedes Classe S (Luxury sedan, 1-3 passengers, high comfort).
2. Mercedes Classe V (Premium van, 1-7 passengers, ideal for groups/luggage).
3. Tesla Model Y (Eco-friendly, modern comfort).
